detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

CJC-1295(No DAC)/Ipamorelin Blend

Chemical Information:
  • CJC-1295 (No DAC)
    • Molecular Formula: C152H252N44O42
    • Molecular Weight: 3367.9 g/mol
    • Sequence: Tyr-D-Ala-Asp-Ala-Ile-Phe-Thr-Gln-Ser-Tyr-Arg-Lys-Val-Leu-Ala-Gln-Leu-Ser-Ala-Arg-Lys-Leu-Leu-Gln-Asp-Ile-Leu-Ser-Arg
  • Ipamorelin
    • Molecular Formula: C38H49N9O5
    • Molecular Weight: 711.86 g/mol
    • Sequence: Aib-His-D-2-Nal-D-Phe-Lys-NH2
Product Description:

CJC-1295 (No DAC) / Ipamorelin is a research blend consisting of two structurally defined synthetic peptides produced through controlled peptide synthesis. The components are combined in a standardized formulation for use in laboratory research environments. This blend is utilized in controlled experimental settings for analytical evaluation of peptide behavior, stability, and interaction within controlled experimental systems. All applications are limited to in vitro research models. The product is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling.

Research Applications:

This peptide blend is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of stability and degradation profiles of combined peptide systems
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay systems
  • Characterization of interactions between peptide components under controlled experimental conditions

Storage and Handling:

  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during handling to ensure sterility.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

CJC-1295(No DAC)/Ipamorelin is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
